text: Algorithm 1 PCGrad Update Rule 0: Model parameters θ \theta , task minibatch ℬ = { 𝒯 k } \mathcal{B}=\{\mathcal{T}_{k}\} 1: 𝐠 k ← ∇ θ ℒ k ​ ( θ ) ​ ∀ k \mathbf{g}_{k}\leftarrow\nabla_{\theta}\mathcal{L}_{k}(\theta)~~\forall k 2: for 𝒯 i ∈ ℬ \mathcal{T}_{i}\in\mathcal{B} do 3: for 𝒯 j ∼ uniformly ℬ ∖ 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{j}\stackrel{{\scriptstyle\text{\scriptsize uniformly}}}{{\sim}}\mathcal{B}\setminus\mathcal{T}_{i} in random order do 4: if 𝐠 i T ​ 𝐠 j < 0 \mathbf{g}_{i}^{T}\mathbf{g}_{j}<0 then 5: // Subtract the projection of 𝐠 i \mathbf{g}_{i} onto 𝐠 j \mathbf{g}_{j} 6: Set 𝐠 i = 𝐠 i − 𝐠 i ⋅ 𝐠 j ‖ 𝐠 j ‖ 2 ​ 𝐠 j \mathbf{g}_{i}=\mathbf{g}_{i}-\frac{\mathbf{g}_{i}\cdot\mathbf{g}_{j}}{\|\mathbf{g}_{j}\|^{2}}\mathbf{g}_{j} 7: end if 8: end for 9: Store 𝐠 i PC = 𝐠 i \mathbf{g}_{i}^{\text{PC}}=\mathbf{g}_{i} 10: end for 11: return update Δ ​ θ = 𝐠 PC = ∑ i 𝐠 i PC \Delta\theta=\mathbf{g}^{\text{PC}}=\sum_{i}\mathbf{g}_{i}^{\text{PC}}
